title: Public Health Equity Act
subjects: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues
Department of Health and Human Services

committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S1286-1287)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Labor and Human Resources.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Labor and Human Resources.

summaries.text: Public Health Equity Act - Amends the Public Health Service Act to add a new title, title XXVII: Public Health Equity. Prohibits, under such title, acts with discriminatory effect as well as intentionally discriminatory acts that result in disproportionate exposure to a covered substance on the basis of race, color, or national origin. Defines a covered substance to include certain hazardous materials, substances, contaminants, or chemicals listed, identified, or defined in specified laws.
